concepts.label: cell co-culturing
concepts.description: A material combination in which cell cultures of two or more different types are are combined and allowed to culture as one.

concepts.label: feed role
concepts.description: a role that inheres in a material entity and is realized in the use of that material entity by lab animal to provide all needed nourishment.

concepts.label: polymerase chain reaction
concepts.description: PCR is the process in which a DNA polymerase is used to amplify a piece of DNA by in vitro enzymatic replication. As PCR progresses, the DNA thus generated is itself used as a template for replication. This sets in motion a chain reaction in which the DNA template is exponentially amplified.

concepts.label: transcription profiling assay
concepts.description: An assay that determines gene expression and transcription activity using ribonucleic acids collected from a material entity.

concepts.label: reverse transcribed polymerase chain reaction
concepts.description: reverse transcribe pcr is a process which allow amplification of cDNA during a pcr reaction while the cDNA results from a retrotranscription of messenger RNA isolated from a material entity.

concepts.label: protein expression profiling assay
concepts.description: An assay that determines protein expression and translation activity using protein extracts collected from a material entity.

concepts.label: animal feeding
concepts.description: animal feeding is a process in which animals are provided with food

concepts.label: chain termination sequencing assay
concepts.description: A DNA sequencing assay which rely on the use of dideoxynucleotides used in 4 distinct sequencing reaction on the same DNA sample. The dideoxynucleotides, once incorporated in the complementary DNA strand being synthesized by the DNA polymerase prevent any further chain elongation. The newly generated sequences are resolved on a polyacrylamide gel using electrophoresis and labels (either fluorochrome or radioactivity) are used to determine the nucleotide present at a given position

concepts.label: survival assessment assay
concepts.description: An assay that measures the occurrence of death events in one or more organisms over time

concepts.label: pathogen challenge
concepts.description: The administration of a live pathogenic organism to a host.

concepts.label: real time polymerase chain reaction assay
concepts.description: An assay, based on the PCR, that amplifies and simultaneously quantifies a specific DNA molecule based on the use of complementary probes/primers. It enables both detection and quantification (as absolute number of copies or relative amount when normalized to DNA input or additional normalizing genes) of one or more specific sequences in a DNA sample.

concepts.label: real time reverse-transcription polymerase chain reaction assay
concepts.description: An assay that uses a reverse transcription step (an RNA strand is reverse transcribed into its DNA complement using the enzyme reverse transcriptase) before a PCR assay.

concepts.label: oral administration
concepts.description: An administering substance in vivo into the mouth of an organism

concepts.label: growth environment
concepts.description: The collection of material entities and their qualities that are located near a live organism, tissue or cell and can influence its growth.

concepts.label: densitometer
concepts.description: A device that measures the degree of darkness (the optical density) of a photographic or semitransparent material or of a reflecting surface.

concepts.label: confocal microscope
concepts.description: A microscope that is used to increase micrograph contrast and/or reconstruct three-dimensional images by using a spatial pinhole to eliminate out-of-focus light in specimens that are thicker than the focal plane.

concepts.label: laser scanning confocal microscope
concepts.description: A confocal microscope that obtains high-resolution optical images with depth selectivity, in which a laser beam passes through a light source aperture and then is focused by an objective lens into a small (ideally diffraction limited) focal volume within or on the surface of a specimen.

concepts.label: agarose gel electrophoresis system
concepts.description: A gel electrophoresis system that is used to separate DNA or RNA molecules by size, achieved by moving negatively charged nucleic acid molecules through an agarose matrix with an electric field.

concepts.label: gene knock out
concepts.description: a genetic transformation that renders a gene non-functional, e.g. due to a point mutation, or the removal of all, or part of, the gene using recombinant methods.

concepts.label: transfection
concepts.description: a genetic transformation which relies on the use of physical, electrical and chemical phenomena to introduce DNA or RNA into a cell

concepts.label: RNA sequencing assay
concepts.description: An assay that determines the sequence of an RNA molecule.

concepts.label: stimulus or stress design
concepts.description: A study design in which the response of an organism(s) to the stress or stimulus is studied, e.g. osmotic stress, heat shock, radiation exposure, behavioral treatment etc.

concepts.label: atmosphere
concepts.description: A growth environment pertaining to the atmospheric conditions that is used to culture or grow an organism.

concepts.label: fluorescence detection assay
concepts.description: An assay in which a material's fluorescence is determined.

concepts.label: sampling time measurement datum
concepts.description: A time measurement datum when an observation is made or a sample is taken from a material as measured from some reference point.

concepts.label: electrophoretic mobility shift assay
concepts.description: An assay that measures information about Protein-DNA or Protein-RNA interactions using gel electrophoresis and relying on the fact the molecular interactions will cause the heterodimer to be retarded on the gel when compared to controls corresponding to protein extract alone and protein extract + neutral nucleic acid.

concepts.label: microarray assay
concepts.description: An analyte assay where binding of the analyte to immobilized matrix is measured.

concepts.label: Illumina HiSeq 2000
concepts.description: A DNA sequencer which is manufactured by the Illumina corporation, with two flow cells and a throughput of up to 55 Gb per day. Built upon sequencing by synthesis technology, the machine is optimized for generation of data for multiple samples in a single run.

concepts.label: reporter gene assay
concepts.description: An assay that detects expression of a reporter gene that was inserted under the control of a regulatory sequence of interest.

concepts.label: pulse stable isotope labeling by amino acids in cell culture
concepts.description: An assay that detects differences in protein abundance using samples that have been metabolically labeled in vivo with a stable non-radioactive heavy isotope containing amino acid for a short period of time. After diluting the pulsed cells into growth media without label, high resolution mass spectrometry-based proteomics is used to analyze the time-dependent decay and determine protein stability.

concepts.label: subcellular protein localization assay
concepts.description: A protein localization assay that determines the specific subcellular location of a protein. The location is visualized through electron microscopy.

concepts.label: suppression subtractive hybridization
concepts.description: An artificially induced nucleic acid hybridization that is performed to compare gene expression in different cell or tissue types based on normalization and suppression, which creates a subtracted cDNA or genomic DNA library.

concepts.label: gene knockdown
concepts.description: A genetic transformation which reduces the expression of a specific gene or genes in an organism.

concepts.label: RNAi gene knockdown
concepts.description: A gene knockdown that silences genes through artificially-induced RNA interference. This is accomplished by introducing small double-stranded interfering RNA complementary to the target mRNA to be silenced, which is then cleaved by a ribonuclease.

concepts.label: RNAi knockdown assay
concepts.description: A gene knockdown assay in which RNAi gene knockdown is used to disrupt gene transcripts.

concepts.label: polymerase chain reaction assay
concepts.description: An assay that uses polymerase chain reaction technique to amplify DNA.

concepts.label: specimen collection time post infection
concepts.description: A specimen collection time measurement datum that is the measure of a time when specimens are collected after an infection starts.

concepts.label: liquid chromatography mass spectrometry assay
concepts.description: A mass spectrometry assay where a sample mixture is first separated by liquid chromatography before being converted into ions which are characterized by using mass spectrometry based on their mass-to-charge ratio and relative abundance.

concepts.label: periodic acid-Schiff staining assay
concepts.description: A histological assay which is used on tissue samples to demonstrate the presence of carbohydrates and carbohydrate compounds such as polysaccharides, mucin, glycogen, or fungal cell wall components.

concepts.label: gas chromatography mass spectrometry assay
concepts.description: A mass spectrometry assay combining mass spectrometry and gas chromatography for the qualitative as well as quantitative determination of compounds.

concepts.label: topical administration
concepts.description: An administration of a substance onto the surface of the skin of an organism.

concepts.label: cell death assay
concepts.description: A cell viability assay which measures the number or proportion of dead cells in a population.

concepts.label: macroscopic examination of material anatomical entity assay
concepts.description: An assay that performs a macroscopic assessment of a material anatomical entity using the sense of sight.

concepts.label: cell death assay using vital dye
concepts.description: A cell death assay that uses the Trypan blue vital dye to stain cells which have lost membrane integrity.

concepts.label: hierarchical clustering
concepts.description: A hierarchical clustering is a data transformation which achieves a class discovery objective, which takes as input data item and builds a hierarchy of clusters. The traditional representation of this hierarchy is a tree (visualized by a dendrogram), with the individual input objects at one end (leaves) and a single cluster containing every object at the other (root).

concepts.label: principal components analysis dimensionality reduction
concepts.description: A principal components analysis dimensionality reduction is a dimensionality reduction achieved by applying principal components analysis and by keeping low-order principal components and excluding higher-order ones.

concepts.label: pearson correlation coefficient calculation
concepts.description: A pearson correlation coefficient calculation is a similarity calculation which attaches to each pair of random variables X and Y the ratio of their covariance by the product of their standard deviations. Given a series of n measurements of X and Y written as x_i and y_i where i = 1, 2, ..., n, then their Pearson correlation coefficient refers to the "sample correlation coefficient" and is written as the sum over i of the ratios (x_i-xbar)*(y_i-ybar)/((n-1)*s_x*s_y) where xbar and ybar are the sample means of X and Y , s_x and s_y are the sample standard deviations of X and Y. The closer the pearson correlation coefficient is to 1, the more similar the inputs are considered.

concepts.label: staining
concepts.description: Staining is a process which results in the addition a class-specific (DNA, proteins, lipids, carbohydrates) dye to a substrate to qualify or quantify the presence of a specific compound.

concepts.label: microarray
concepts.description: A processed material that is made to be used in an analyte assay. It consists of a physical immobilisation matrix in which substances that bind the analyte are placed in regular spatial position.

concepts.label: DNA microarray
concepts.description: A DNA-microarray is a microarray that is used as a physical 2D immobilisation matrix for DNA sequences. DNA microarray-bound DNA fragments are used as targets for a hybridising probed sample.

concepts.label: histological assay
concepts.description: An assay that uses visual examination of cells or tissue (or images of them) to make an assessment regarding a quality of the cells or tissue. This assay can include steps of staining, imaging, and judgement.

concepts.label: addition of molecular label
concepts.description: a material processing technique intended to add a molecular label to some input material entity, to allow detection of the molecular target of this label in a detection of molecular label assay

concepts.label: electrophoresis
concepts.description: a protocol application that uses an electrical potential to move material through a defined matrix in order to separate it by its resistance to movement and its charge

concepts.label: transgenic organism
concepts.description: a transgenic organism is material entity which derives from an organism which has been modified to express a gene not normally part of it

concepts.label: administration in vivo with infectious agent
concepts.description: is an administration of an infectious agent to a host organism

concepts.label: infection process
concepts.description: the detrimental process in which an infectious agent colonizes or replicates in a host environment

concepts.label: chemical stress exposure
concepts.description: A chemical exposure (PECO:0007189) that induces stress.

concepts.label: oxidative stress exposure
concepts.description: A chemical stress exposure (PECO:0001036) involving use of oxidative stress-inducing chemicals.

concepts.label: osmotic stress exposure
concepts.description: A chemical stress exposure (PECO:0001036) involving use of osmotic stress-inducing chemicals.

concepts.label: elevated carbon dioxide exposure
concepts.description: A carbon dioxide exposure (PECO:0001020) involving an increased concentration of carbon dioxide (CHEBI:16526).

concepts.label: control exposure
concepts.description: A plant exposure (PECO:0001001) used as a reference to compare the effects of one or more treatment factors in a study.

concepts.label: summer season exposure
concepts.description: An exposure involving growth during the summer season.

concepts.label: sodium chloride exposure
concepts.description: An exposure involving the use of sodium chloride salt in the growth media.

concepts.label: high light intensity exposure
concepts.description: A light intensity exposure (PECO:0007224) where the intensity of the light for plant growth is between 500–1,000 foot-candles.

concepts.label: moderate light intensity exposure
concepts.description: A light intensity exposure (PECO:0007224) where the intensity of the light for plant growth is between 200–1,000 foot-candles.

concepts.label: high temperature exposure
concepts.description: The treatment involving an exposure to above optimal temperature.

concepts.label: temperature exposure
concepts.description: A physical plant exposure (PECO:0007316) involving a treatment or exposure of a plant structure (PO:0009011) to variations in temperature.

concepts.label: abiotic plant exposure
concepts.description: A plant exposure (PECO:0001001) involving the application of chemical or non-biological factors.

concepts.label: water environment exposure
concepts.description: A physical plant exposure (PECO:0007316) involving an exposure of varying amounts of water and watering frequencies, which may depend on regional environment.

concepts.label: long day length exposure
concepts.description: The treatment involving exposure of plant to long day light duration followed by a short night cycle.

concepts.label: virus plant exposure
concepts.description: A biotic plant exposure (PECO:0007357) involving exposure of a plant to a virus or a combination of two or more viruses.

concepts.label: ultraviolet light exposure
concepts.description: A radiation quality exposure (PECO:0007154) involving the exposure to electromagnetic radiation in the wavelength range of 100-400 nm.

concepts.label: light intensity exposure
concepts.description: An exposure of a plant or a plant part to the amount of light energy incident upon (or flowing through) a unit area in unit time.

concepts.label: plant study condition
concepts.description: A plant experimental condition (PECO:0007359) or set of conditions describing what kind of plant growth facility was used for the experiment.

concepts.label: bacterial plant exposure
concepts.description: A biotic plant exposure (PECO:0007357) involving exposure of a plant to bacteria.

concepts.label: field study
concepts.description: A plant study condition (PECO:0007231) where the plants were grown outdoors under field conditions.

concepts.label: soil water content exposure
concepts.description: The treatment involving an exposure to varying amounts of water in soil growth media.

concepts.label: high air temperature exposure
concepts.description: The treatment involving an exposure to above optimal air temperature, which may depend on the study type or the regional environment.

concepts.label: high water temperature exposure
concepts.description: The treatment involving an exposure to above optimal water temperature, which may depend on the study type or the regional environment.

concepts.label: mechanical damage exposure
concepts.description: A physical plant exposure (PECO:0007316) involving a treatment or exposure of a plant structure (PO:0009011) to mechanical damage.

concepts.label: watering exposure
concepts.description: The treatment involving an exposure to watering frequencies.

concepts.label: drought exposure
concepts.description: A water environment exposure (PECO:0007198) which is the treatment or exposure of plants to a prolonged dry period.

concepts.label: whole plant
concepts.description: A plant structure (PO:0005679) which is a whole organism.

concepts.label: plant protoplast
concepts.description: A cultured plant cell from which the entire plant cell wall has been removed.

concepts.label: leaf-derived cultured plant cell
concepts.description: A cultured plant cell that was derived from leaf tissue.

concepts.label: cauline leaf
concepts.description: A vascular leaf (PO:0009025), borne on the stem (PO:0009047).

concepts.label: root tip
concepts.description: A cardinal organ part (PO:0025001) which is the apical portion of the root (PO:0009005), and includes the root apical meristem (PO:0020147) and root cap (PO:0020123).

concepts.label: sclerenchyma cell
concepts.description: A ground tissue cell (PO:0025030) with a lignified secondary cell wall.

concepts.label: seed development stage
concepts.description: A multi-tissue plant structure development stage (PO:0025571) that has as primary participant a seed (PO:0009010).

concepts.label: plant epidermal cell
concepts.description: A native plant cell (PO:0025606) that is part of a portion of epidermis (PO:0005679).

concepts.label: glandular trichome
concepts.description: A trichome (PO:0000282) that secretes or sequesters a portion of plant substance (PO:0025161).

concepts.label: IE.02 1/2 of inflorescence emerged from flag leaf sheath stage
concepts.description: The stage at which 1/2 of inflorescence has emerged from flag leaf sheath.

concepts.label: seed germination stage
concepts.description: A sporophyte vegetative stage (PO:0007134) which begins with the onset of a seed imbibition stage (PO:0007022) and ends with a radicle emergence stage (PO: 0007015), or a coleorhiza emergence stage (PO:0025475), as a result of the growth by the plant embryo (PO:0004537) in a seed (PO:0009010).

concepts.label: 2 formation of axillary shoot stage
concepts.description: The stage at which the axillary shoots are forming.

concepts.label: early rosette growth stage
concepts.description: Rosette has reached approximately 20% of its final diameter.

concepts.label: seedling development stage
concepts.description: A sporophyte vegetative stage (PO:0007134) that succeeds the seed germination stage (PO:0007057) and terminates with the development of the first adult vascular leaf (PO:0006340).

concepts.label: sporophyte vegetative stage
concepts.description: A sporophyte development stage (PO:0028002) that occurs during the interval between the first division of a plant zygote (PO:0000423) and the formation of a sporangium (PO:0025094).

concepts.label: flowering stage
concepts.description: A flower development stage (PO:0007615) that begins when pollen (PO:0025281) is released by anther dehiscence (GO:0009901) and/or the stigma (PO:0009073) is receptive and ends with the process of pollination (GO:0009856) and/or floral organ senescence (GO:0080187).

concepts.label: seed maturation stage
concepts.description: Stage during which the seed storage products (storage proteins, lipids and starch) are being accumulated, either in the cotyledons or in the endosperm. Also, LEA proteins are accumulated and subsequently, a desiccation tolerant state is reached at the end of this stage.

concepts.label: stomatal pore
concepts.description: A plant anatomical space that forms an opening in an epidermis, flanked by two guard cells.

concepts.label: seedling
concepts.description: A whole plant (PO:0000003) in the seedling development stage (PO:0007131).

concepts.label: fruit
concepts.description: A multi-tissue plant structure (PO:0025496) that develops from a gynoecium (PO:0009062), or a single carpel (PO:0009030), and at maturity may have as parts one or more seeds (PO:0009010).

concepts.label: root
concepts.description: A plant axis (PO:0025004) that lacks shoot axis nodes (PO:0005004) and usually grows indeterminately.

concepts.label: shoot system
concepts.description: A collective plant organ structure (PO:0025007) that produces shoot-borne portions of meristem tissue (PO:0009013) and the plant structures (PO:0009011) that arise from them.

concepts.label: portion of plant tissue
concepts.description: A plant structure (PO:0009011) that consists predominantly of similarly specialized plant cells (PO:0009002) of one or more types.

concepts.label: plant embryo
concepts.description: A whole plant (PO:0000003) that participates in the plant embryo stage (PO:0007631).

concepts.label: seed
concepts.description: A multi-tissue plant structure (PO:0025496) that develops from a plant ovule (PO:0020003) and has as parts a plant embryo (PO:0009009) enclosed in a seed coat (PO:0009088).

concepts.label: plant structure development stage
concepts.description: A stage in the life of a plant structure (PO:0009011) during which the plant structure undergoes developmental processes.

concepts.label: vascular leaf
concepts.description: A leaf (PO:0025034) in a vascular plant.

concepts.label: stem
concepts.description: A shoot axis (PO:0025029) that is the primary axis of a plant.

concepts.label: inflorescence
concepts.description: A reproductive shoot system (PO:0025082) that has as parts all of the shoot axes (PO:0025029) and flowers (PO:0009046; must have two or more) distal to the most distal leaf (PO:0009025).

concepts.label: anther
concepts.description: A collective plant organ structure (PO:0025007) that is the pollen-bearing part of a stamen (PO:0009029).

concepts.label: coleoptile
concepts.description: A sheath-like plant organ (PO:0009008) that surrounds the plumule (PO:0020032) of a plant embryo (PO:0009009) or the emerging shoot apex (PO:0000037) of a seedling.

concepts.label: leaf lamina
concepts.description: A phyllome lamina (PO:0025396) that is the part of a leaf (PO:0025034) exclusive of the petiole (PO:0020038) or leaf sheath (PO:0020104), if either is present.

concepts.label: hypocotyl
concepts.description: A stem internode (PO:0020142) below the cotyledonary node (PO:0025321) and transitional to a root (PO:0009005) of a plant embryo (PO:0009009) or a seedling (PO:0000003).

concepts.label: shoot apical meristem
concepts.description: A shoot system meristem (PO:0006079) formed at the apex of the shoot axis (PO:0025029), including those originating from an axillary bud meristem (PO:0000232).

concepts.label: root system
concepts.description: A collective plant organ structure (PO:0025007) that produces root meristems (PO:0006085), the plant structures (PO:0009011) that arise from them and the parts thereof.

concepts.label: leaf
concepts.description: A phyllome (PO:0006001) that is not associated with a reproductive structure.

concepts.label: papilla cell
concepts.description: An epidermal pavement cell with a short protuberance.

concepts.label: tuber
concepts.description: A plant axis (PO:0025004) that is radially enlarged.

concepts.label: multicellular trichome tip
concepts.description: A portion of plant tissue (PO:0009007) that is the apical most portion of a multicellular trichome apex (PO:0025551).

concepts.label: vegetative shoot system
concepts.description: A shoot system (PO:0009006) that has as parts only vegetative tissues and organs.

concepts.label: root dry weight
concepts.description: The average dry weight of the root determined in a study.

concepts.label: grain aroma trait
concepts.description: A grain quality trait (TO:0000162) which is the aroma of the cooked or uncooked grains.

concepts.label: leaf relative water content
concepts.description: Leaf relative water content is determined at midday (12.00 noon).

concepts.label: spikelet fertility
concepts.description: A spikelet morphology trait (TO:0000657) which is the fertility to a spikelet (PO:0009051).

concepts.label: drought sensitivity
concepts.description: Drought sensitivity is highly interactive with crop phenology, plant growth prior to stress, and timing, duration, and intensity of drought stress. For many soils, it takes at least 2 rainless weeks to cause marked differences in drought sensitivity during the vegetative stage and at least 7 rainless days during the reproductive stage to cause severe drought injury. Leaf rolling precedes leaf drying during drought. Repeated ratings are recommended through progress of the drought.

concepts.label: plant height
concepts.description: A whole plant morphology trait (TO:0000398) which is the height of a whole plant (PO:0000003).

concepts.label: root length
concepts.description: A root morphology trait (TO:0000043) which is the length of a root (PO:0009005).

concepts.label: plant vigor trait
concepts.description: A plant trait (TO:0000387) which is a measure of the active and/or healthy growth and development of a plant stucture (PO:0009011) or a population of plants.

concepts.label: high temperature stress response
concepts.description: A temperature stress response trait (TO:0000432) which is the response to warmer than normal growth conditions.

concepts.label: drought tolerance
concepts.description: Becoming tolerant to drought like conditions of minimal or no water content in the growth environment.

concepts.label: seedling vigor
concepts.description: Represents the seedling growth of the plant.

concepts.label: chlorophyll ratio
concepts.description: A chlorophyll content trait (TO:0000495) which is the ratio of chlorophyll a to chlorophyll b in a plant structure (PO:0009011).

concepts.label: bacterial disease response
concepts.description: A microbial disease response (TO:0000112) trait which is the response to damage to a plant structure (PO:0009011) caused by an infection by a bacterium (NCBITaxon:2).

concepts.label: photosynthetic ability
concepts.description: The photosynthesis ability determined on a plant structure (PO:0009011) under stress.

concepts.label: rubisco to soluble protein ratio
concepts.description: A ratio of the amount of rubisco protein to that of the soluble protein content in a plant structure (PO:0009011).

concepts.label: plant dry weight
concepts.description: The dry weight of the whole plant.

concepts.label: plant growth and development trait
concepts.description: A plant trait (TO:0000387) which is the growth (GO:0048590) and development (GO:0032502) of a plant anatomical entity (PO:0025131) or a constituent cellular component (GO:0005575).

concepts.label: yield trait
concepts.description: A plant trait (TO:0000387) which is a harvestable product that is a plant anatomical entity (PO:0025131) or one or more constituent cellular components (GO:0005575) contained therein.

concepts.label: drought stress response trait
concepts.description: A water stress response trait (TO:0000237) which is a response by a plant structure (PO:0009011) to growth conditions with lower than optimal water availability.

concepts.label: grain yield trait
concepts.description: A fruit yield trait (TO:0000871) that is the amount of grain.

concepts.label: germination rate
concepts.description: Rate of germination of the seed.

concepts.label: temperature stress response trait
concepts.description: An abiotic plant stress response trait (TO:0000168) which is the response to temperature stress.

concepts.label: plant male sterility
concepts.description: A plant sterility trait (TO:0000485) which is the incompetence of pollen (PO:0025281) to fertilize the plant egg cell (PO:0020094).

concepts.label: plant fresh weight
concepts.description: Fresh weight of the plant.

concepts.label: biomass yield
concepts.description: A yield trait (TO:0000371) which is the amount of biomass obtained.

concepts.label: cell membrane stability
concepts.description: A drought stress response trait (TO:0000394) which is the changes in the stability of the cell membrane during water deficit stress.

concepts.label: root penetration index
concepts.description: Its the fraction of number of penetrated roots over the total number of roots.

concepts.label: plant nutrient response trait
concepts.description: A biochemical response trait (TO:0000277) which is the plant's response to an excess or deficient amount of the nutrients in the growth environment.

concepts.label: chlorophyll content
concepts.description: A pigment content trait (TO:0000494) which is a measure of the chlorophyll a and/or chlorophyll b content in a plant structure (PO:0009011).

concepts.label: leaf temperature
concepts.description: A leaf morphology trait (TO:0000748) which is the leaf surface temperature.

concepts.label: stomatal conductance
concepts.description: It is a numerical measure of the maximum rate of passage of either water vapour or carbon dioxide through the stomata.

concepts.label: leaf area trait
concepts.description: A leaf morphology trait (TO:0000748) which is the total area of a leaf (PO:0025034).

concepts.label: shoot dry weight
concepts.description: The dry weight of the shoot without inflorescence.

concepts.label: root fresh weight
concepts.description: The average fresh weight of the root determined in a study.

concepts.label: plant quality trait
concepts.description: A plant trait (TO:0000387) that contributes to the overall utility, nutritional, or economic value of a plant, plant structure (PO:0009011) or plant product

concepts.label: NCLB area under disease progress curve
concepts.description: A maize northern leaf blight disease response trait (TO:0000691) which is the area under the disease progress curve.

concepts.label: turgor pressure
concepts.description: The pressure within the cell resulting from the absorption of water into the vacuole and the imbibition of water by the protoplasm.

concepts.label: subterranean shoot axis tuber mass
concepts.description: A subterranean shoot axis tuber morphology trait (TO:0000742) which is the mass of a subterranean shoot axis tuber (PO:0004547).

concepts.label: seed yield trait
concepts.description: A shoot system yield trait (TO:0000327) which is the yield of seeds (PO:0009010).

concepts.label: photosynthetic rate
concepts.description: The total amount of carbon fixed by the plant per unit time and is measured by determining the changes in CO2 concentration over a plant leaf in a glass enclosure.

concepts.label: water use efficiency
concepts.description: As determined by the ratio of photosynthetic rate to transpiration rate.

concepts.label: transpiration rate
concepts.description: The rate of transpiration.

concepts.label: net photosynthetic rate
concepts.description: It is measured as the difference between gross photosynthesis (the total amount of carbon fixed by the plant per unit time) and the respiration (the total amount of carbon lost metabolically during that same time).

concepts.label: shoot axis tuber yield
concepts.description: A shoot system yield trait (TO:0000327) which is the yield of shoot axis tubers (PO:0004543).

concepts.label: leaflet area
concepts.description: A leaflet morphology trait (TO:0001113) which is the area (PATO:0001323) of a leaflet (PO:0020049).

concepts.label: survival rate after freezing temperature stress
concepts.description: A freezing stress response trait (TO:0001151) which is the percentage of plants that survive freezing temperature exposure.

concepts.label: fatty acid content trait
concepts.description: A metabolite content trait (TO:0000281) which is the amount of one or more fatty acids in a plant structure (PO:0009011) or a plant-derived lipid.

concepts.label: fruit color
concepts.description: A fruit morphology trait (TO:0002617) which is the color of a fruit (PO:0009001).

concepts.label: oxidative stress response
concepts.description: A chemical stress response trait (TO:0000482) reactive oxygen species in the growth environment.

concepts.label: leaf sheath length
concepts.description: A leaf sheath morphology trait (TO:0000835) which is the length of the leaf sheath (PO:0020104).

concepts.label: proline content
concepts.description: Amino acid proline content in a plant structure (PO:0009011).

concepts.label: calcium content trait
concepts.description: A mineral and ion content trait (TO:0000465) which is the calcium cation (CHEBI:39123) composition in a plant structure (PO:0009011).

concepts.label: leaf chlorosis
concepts.description: A leaf color trait (TO:0006060) describing the yellowing of leaves, due to insufficient production of chlorophyll.

concepts.label: seedling hypocotyl length
concepts.description: A seedling hypocotyl morphology trait (TO:0000769) which is the length of a seedling hypocotyl (PO:0025291).

concepts.label: quantum yield
concepts.description: A chlorophyll fluorescence trait (TO:0012006) which is the efficiency of light energy conversion into chemical energy by plants.

concepts.label: nitrogen content
concepts.description: A mineral and ion content trait (TO:0000465) which is the amount of nitrogen (CHEBI:51143) in a plant structure (PO:0009011).

concepts.label: degree Celsius
concepts.description: A temperature unit which is equal to one kelvin degree. However, they have their zeros at different points. The centigrade scale has its zero at 273.15 K.

concepts.label: minute
concepts.description: A time unit which is equal to 60 seconds.

concepts.label: hour
concepts.description: A time unit which is equal to 3600 seconds or 60 minutes.

concepts.label: day
concepts.description: A time unit which is equal to 24 hours.

concepts.label: week
concepts.description: A time unit which is equal to 7 days.

concepts.label: millimolar
concepts.description: A unit of molarity which is equal to one thousandth of a molar or 10^[-3] M.

concepts.label: century
concepts.description: A time unit which is equal to 100 years.

concepts.label: parts per hundred
concepts.description: A dimensionless concentration notation which denotes the amount of a given substance in a total amount of 100 regardless of the units of measure as long as they are the same.

concepts.label: percent
concepts.description: A dimensionless ratio unit which denotes numbers as fractions of 100.

concepts.label: fraction
concepts.description: A dimensionless ratio unit which relates the part (the numerator) to the whole (the denominator).

concepts.label: colony forming unit per milliliter
concepts.description: A colony forming unit which a measure of viable bacterial numbers in one milliliter.

concepts.label: microgram per milliliter
concepts.description: A mass unit density which is equal to mass of an object in micrograms divided by the volume in millliters.

concepts.label: fold dilution
concepts.description: A unit that is the ratio of concentration of two solutions of interest, typically with one solution derived from the other by the addition of solvent.

concepts.label: mega base pair
concepts.description: A unit equal to one million base pairs

concepts.label: micromole per kilogram
concepts.description: A specific concentration unit which is equal to 1 micromole of a given substance per kilogram of solvent.

concepts.label: hectare
concepts.description: An area unit which is equal to an area of 10,000 square meters. Equivalent to 2.471 acres.

Expression analysis of StWRKY65 in potato under abiotic stress
This study systematically analyzed the expression profiles of the StWRKY65 gene in leaves of two potato cultivars (‘Desiree’ and ‘Atlantic’) under various abiotic stress conditions ( Figures 2A–L ).
Under drought stress, StWRKY65 exhibited expression patterns correlated with stress severity and cultivar specificity.

In ‘Desiree’, 10% PEG6000 treatment induced a stable upregulation (with relatively steady increases at 1, 3, 6, 12, and 48 h post-treatment, peaking at 6 h), whereas 20% PEG6000 triggered fluctuating upregulation (rapid induction at 1 h, followed by a decline at 3 h, then gradual increases at 6, 12, and 24 h, reaching a peak at 24 h) ( Figures 2A–C ), suggesting its positive regulatory role under severe drought.

In ‘Atlantic’, 10% PEG6000 elicited oscillatory expression (upregulation at 1, 3, 24, and 48 h but downregulation at 6 and 12 h), while 20% PEG6000 induced variable upregulation (peaking at 12 h) ( Figures 2B–D ), indicating its potential involvement in drought resistance.

This strict nuclear localization pattern confirms that StWRKY65 specifically resides in the nucleus, a key characteristic of functional TFs involved in transcriptional regulation.

relations.evidence_preview: This paper provides compelling evidence on the functionality of StWRKY1 transcription factor, in a compatible interaction of potato–Phytophthora infestans, to extend our knowledge on the regulation of the metabolic pathway genes leading to strengthening the secondary cell wall.
A metabolomics approach was used to identify resistance-related metabolites belonging to the phenylpropanoid pathway and their biosynthetic genes regulated by StWRKY1.
This study provides convincing evidence on the role of StWRKY1 in the regulation of downstream genes to biosynthesize HCAAs, which are deposited to reinforce secondary cell walls.

relations.triple: transcription factors affects secondary cell wall biosynthetic genes
relations.evidence_preview: The biosynthesis of the secondary cell wall is a developmental process that involves the co-ordinated expression of secondary cell wall biosynthetic genes regulated by a cascade of transcription factors.

The first line of defence following infection involves the recognition of pathogen-associated molecular patterns (PAMPs), which trigger basal levels of plant defence responses referred to as PAMP-triggered immunity (PTI).

relations.triple: R genes encodes effector-specific resistance (R) proteins

The resulting hypersensitive reaction or effector-triggered immunity (ETI) constitutes qualitative resistance.

Following recognition of PAMPs, the receptors trigger a phosphorylation cascade through the mitogen-activated protein kinase (MAPK) signalling pathway, leading to the induction or repression of target genes.

Among the induced target genes are a variety of transcription factors that regulate plant defence responses involving up- or down-regulation of resistance-related (RR) genes by binding to specific DNA sequences in their promoter regions.

The present study was designed to elucidate the mechanisms by which StWRKY1 regulates the downstream genes leading to quantitative resistance to late blight in potato based on a metabolomics approach.
We identified high-fold-change RR metabolites in potato stems based on non-targeted metabolomics of two genotypes: a resistant (F06025) and a susceptible (Shepody) genotype.

As reported by others, a high fold change in abundance of phenylpropanoid metabolites was observed in stems that appears to play a major role in late blight resistance by enhancing cell wall thickening through deposition of polyaromatic domains of suberin.

Comparative analysis of the heat‐responsive transcriptomic signatures of leaves highlighted conserved to genotype‐specific reprogramming at transcriptional levels.

Hierarchical clustering clearly divided the cultivars into four clades based on their HS response, viz. The genomic variations between different cultivars within the same species are often armed with specific mechanisms to tolerate stress at morphological, physiological and molecular levels (Huang and Gao,). Tomato production has considerably increased in the tropical and sub‐tropical regions (Nicola et al.,; Srivastava et al.,). To exploit the variability in thermotolerance, 9 tomato cultivars from Indian sub‐continent were screened and graded as tolerant and sensitive to shortlist best contrasting pair. These cultivars included five tolerant [CLN, IIHR2201, IIHR2274, Pusa Sadabahar and Hisar Arun] and four sensitive cultivars (CA4, Pusa Ruby, Pusa Rohini and Pusa120) (Chavan et al.,; Kartikeya et al.,; Meena and Bahadur,; Sangu et al.,). The tolerance of cultivars to HS was judged based on the parameters adopted by several previous reports for screening tomato cultivars under HS (Abdul‐Baki,; Abdul‐Baki and Stommel,). These include survival assays at seedling stage (Figure S1a) and at 1‐month‐old stage (Figure S1b); physiological assays like proline content, relative water content (RWC) and electrolytic leakage (EL) (Figure S1c–e); and yield‐related traits like percentage of fruit set per plant and total fruit yield (Figure S1f,g). Higher values for all the above parameters and lower values for EL are hallmarks of better thermotolerance. The cultivars were ranked for their performance by assaying all the above parameters as percentage increase/decrease under HS relative to control conditions. CLN displayed highest ranking among the cultivars for all the above parameters except EL (Figure 1a and Figure S1e). CA4 on the other hand had highest EL and obtained lowest rank for all other parameters except proline content where Pusa Ruby had least value (Figure 1a; Figure S1c). Of note, percentage survival of 1‐month‐old CLN plants was more than 80%, whereas it was mere 11% in CA4. Fruit set was also higher in CLN (81%) as compared to CA4 (27%), as reflected by nearly 50% yield being maintained in CLN but only 6% in CA4 (Figure S1f,g). Hierarchical clustering clearly divided the cultivars into four clades based on their HS response, viz. (i) most tolerant (CLN), (ii) moderately tolerant (Pusa Sadabahar, IIHR2274, Hisar Arun and IIHR2201), (iii) sensitive (Pusa Ruby, Pusa‐120 and Pusa Rohini) and (iv) highly sensitive (CA4) (Figure 1a). This was further strengthened by PCA of all the above factors that showed the separation of each cultivar on PC1 (82.8%) based on the performance under HS, placing CLN and CA4 on the two extremities (Figure 1b), thus identifying them as the most tolerant and sensitive cultivars to HS, respectively. CLN is reported to be tolerant to salt stress (Saeed et al.,) and TMV infection (https://avrdc.org). CLN has been shown to have higher plant vigour and pollen viability as compared to sensitive CA4 (Sangu et al.,). In addition, CLN is reported to maintain highest percentage of seeded fruits under HS as compared to several other cultivars (Comlekcioglu and Soylu,). The CLN and CA4 pair has been used as donor parents for generating mapping populations towards HS (https://avrdc.org). Thus, decoding the transcriptome of these two cultivars in HS response should provide valuable resource for future research to improve thermotolerance in tomato.

Furthermore, proteins belonging to chaperones, winged helix TFs, mRNA splicing and processing factors were significantly enriched among the conserved up‐regulated genes (Figure S3c).

In regions of extreme drought and heat, such as the Middle East, cultivating tomato is a real challenge. In addition, tomato yellow leaf curl virus (TYLCV), a whitefly-transmitted begomovirus, thrives in the same regions. Often, the combination of these biotic (TYLCV) and abiotic (heat, drought) stresses cause a yield reduction up to total loss. Therefore, there is a need to improve the tolerance of crops to the combined effects of high temperature, drought, and insect-transmitted diseases. By understanding the complex mechanisms of plant responses to these stresses, it might be possible to develop strategies relying on genes, proteins, and metabolites expression profiling, aimed at adapting these plants to harsh environments. This is not unfeasible since we have previously shown that TYLCV infection could prompt protection from heat stress.
